name: harnessloop
description: Goal-driven harness loops with evidence gates, self-audit, and file-system handoffs.

interface.longDescription: Harnessloop installs a project-local protocol for long-term goal loops, data freshness controls, runtime validation, minimal-change scope locks, file-system handoffs, subagent delegation, adversarial review, self-audit, and upstream evolution issue handling.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Harnessloop to run a goal-driven loop.
